title: Counter-Selector Wave 40: cross-host registry migration and application continuation
purpose: Adjudicate one bounded Podman checkpoint-image route that joins registry push, different-system pull, and restore commands, one distinct cross-host checkpoint-archive procedure that demonstrates application state continuation, and one compatibility/refusal control, without combining package variants or converting documentation into an observed same-package registry handoff.

complete_portable_operational_handoff_re: outgoing and incoming authority and credential custody

controls.public_label: same-system documented checkpoint-image registry migration route
controls.system_or_subject: Podman checkpoint image push, different-system pull, and restore route

source_records.title: Podman checkpoint image creation and different-system registry migration contract
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines --create-image as a standard OCI image with one checkpoint layer and states that it can be pushed to a standard registry and pulled on a different system to enable migration.

source_records.title: Podman checkpoint-image registry push, pull, and restore command route
source_records.artifact_scope: Shows one looper container, creation of a registry-named checkpoint image, podman push, podman pull on a different system, and podman container restore from the pulled image.

source_records.title: Podman restore from checkpoint image contract
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines restore inputs as container or checkpoint-image IDs or names and documents restore from one checkpoint image, including renaming and compatibility-sensitive options.

source_records.title: OCI Distribution Specification v1.1.1
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines registry push and pull APIs, permits manifest references by tag or digest, and requires registries to retain uploaded manifest bytes and expose digest-addressed retrieval semantics.

source_records.title: OCI content descriptor contract
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines content descriptors that bind referenced bytes by digest and size and support independent digest verification.

components.same_object_identity: One documented Podman route keeps one registry-named checkpoint OCI image as the object passed through create-image, push, different-system pull, and restore commands.
components.checkpoint_package_identity: The package is a standard OCI checkpoint image with one layer containing the checkpoint files and host-environment annotations.
components.exact_package_selector: The route examples use an image repository name or tag; no literal fixed checkpoint digest is retained in a public restore receipt.
components.package_content_addressing: OCI descriptors and registry manifests are content-addressable, but the documented Podman route does not show the successor selecting a retained checkpoint digest.
components.internal_inventory_and_entry_integrity: The outer image graph binds a layer and configuration, but no itemized integrity-bound inventory acknowledges every checkpoint entry and external obligation.
components.outgoing_and_incoming_roles: A source system and a different destination system are described, but no named incoming recipient accepts custody.
components.destination_boundary: The documentation says a different system may pull and restore the image; it does not prove a demonstrably clean destination or absence of predecessor state.
components.authority_and_credentials: Registry login is shown as a prerequisite, but authority, credentials, revocation, and post-transfer custody are not transferred or acknowledged.
components.dependencies_and_access: Compatible Podman, OCI runtime, CRIU, kernel features, rootfs image, networking, mounts, and registry access remain external dependencies.
components.open_decisions_and_deadlines: No complete ledger binds unresolved operational decisions, deadlines, ownership, or escalation state.
components.rollback_safe_decline_and_failure_contai: The route contains no same-package rollback, safe-decline, or bounded-failure receipt.
components.recipient_or_successor_acknowledgment: Pulling or restoring the image is not an explicit acknowledgment of an itemized operational inventory.
components.successor_operation_from_package: A restore command from the pulled checkpoint image is documented, but no application-specific output is observed after that registry round trip.
components.independent_verification: No external independent party reproduces the complete registry-to-operation chain from the exact same package.

positive_findings: Podman defines a checkpoint OCI image that can use standard registry infrastructure.
The same documented route includes checkpoint-image creation, push, different-system pull, and restore commands.
OCI distribution permits manifest retrieval by digest or tag and preserves manifest bytes.
Checkpoint-image annotations expose selected source-environment metadata.
The destination command restores from the pulled checkpoint-image reference.
known_limits: No public receipt retains the literal checkpoint digest used by the destination restore.
No observed push response, pull digest, or restore log joins the complete route.
A different-system command is not evidence of a clean or fresh destination.
The example does not observe application-specific continuation after the pulled image is restored.
The OCI image graph is not an itemized inventory of every checkpoint file and external dependency.
Registry login does not transfer or acknowledge complete authority and credential custody.
No rollback or safe-decline operation is demonstrated.
No named recipient acknowledges the package inventory.
No external independent reproduction exists.
The documented route cannot borrow the archive control's cross-host application output.

controls.system_or_subject: Red Hat Podman archive migration procedure

source_records.title: Container migration with Podman on RHEL
source_records.artifact_scope: Shows a counter service returning 0 and 1 on the source host, checkpoint export, transfer to other_host, restore on other_host, and a subsequent response of 2.

source_records.title: Podman checkpoint archive export contract
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines exported checkpoint archives and distinguishes their rootfs and volume inclusion choices from checkpoint OCI images.

source_records.title: Podman checkpoint archive import and runtime compatibility refusal
source_records.artifact_scope: Defines import from another host and states that restore aborts when the requested runtime does not match the runtime recorded during container creation.

components.same_object_identity: One exported Podman checkpoint archive is copied from the source host to other_host and supplied to restore.
components.checkpoint_package_identity: The package is an exported checkpoint archive, not the checkpoint OCI image used by the registry-route control.
components.exact_package_selector: A filesystem path names the transferred archive; no public digest identifies the exact bytes.
components.package_content_addressing: The procedure does not bind the archive to an immutable registry or public digest.
components.internal_inventory_and_entry_integrity: The archive may include rootfs changes and volume content, but no itemized manifest acknowledges every internal entry.
components.outgoing_and_incoming_roles: The procedure distinguishes source host and other_host but does not identify accountable outgoing and incoming custodians.
components.destination_boundary: The restored successor runs on another host, yet the destination is not proven clean, fresh, isolated, or predecessor-state-free.
components.authority_and_credentials: Host access and transfer authority are assumed; credential transfer and revocation are not inventoried.
components.dependencies_and_access: The destination requires compatible runtime state and the base container image, acquired separately through registry or explicit image transfer.
components.open_decisions_and_deadlines: No complete decision, deadline, or ownership ledger accompanies the archive.
components.rollback_safe_decline_and_failure_contai: Runtime mismatch aborts fail closed, but no application rollback or recipient safe-decline receipt is shown.
components.recipient_or_successor_acknowledgment: Successful restore and curl output are operation receipts, not acknowledgment of an operational inventory.
components.successor_operation_from_package: The counter returns 0 and 1 before checkpoint and 2 after restore on other_host, demonstrating application-specific continuation.
components.independent_verification: The official procedure is not an external independent reproduction of one delivered package.

positive_findings: The source and destination hosts are explicitly distinct.
One exported archive is transferred and supplied to restore on the destination host.
Application output advances from 0 and 1 before checkpoint to 2 after destination restore.
The destination successor therefore continues state rather than restarting the counter at zero.
A runtime mismatch is specified to abort rather than silently substitute an incompatible runtime.
known_limits: The archive is not selected by a public fixed digest.
The procedure uses direct file transfer rather than a registry push and pull.
The destination base image is an external dependency and may require separate transfer.
Different host does not prove a clean or hidden-state-free destination.
No itemized archive-entry inventory is acknowledged by a recipient.
No authority, credential, access, or decision ledger accompanies the archive.
Runtime refusal is not a complete rollback or safe-decline protocol.
The operation receipt may not be borrowed into the checkpoint-image registry route.
No external independent party reproduces the complete chain.
No complete operational handoff is established.

controls.public_label: checkpoint compatibility metadata and fail-closed runtime boundary
controls.system_or_subject: Podman checkpoint annotations and restore compatibility controls

source_records.title: Podman checkpoint-image source-environment annotations
source_records.artifact_scope: Lists checkpoint name, raw image name, rootfs image ID, runtime, architecture, kernel, CRIU, and Podman metadata that can be inspected on a checkpoint image.

source_records.title: Podman fail-closed restore compatibility contract
source_records.artifact_scope: Requires compatible runtime and restore options for file locks and TCP state and aborts restore when the selected runtime does not match the recorded runtime.

source_records.title: RHEL Podman destination-image and compatibility prerequisites
source_records.artifact_scope: States that the destination needs the original container image, obtained from a registry or transferred separately, before restoring the checkpoint archive.

components.same_object_identity: Checkpoint annotations and restore checks are tied to the Podman checkpoint package being inspected or restored.
components.checkpoint_package_identity: The package records selected source container and host-environment metadata.
components.exact_package_selector: Compatibility metadata does not retain the destination's exact checkpoint digest selection.
components.package_content_addressing: An OCI checkpoint image may be content-addressed, while an exported archive may not be; this control does not merge those variants.
components.internal_inventory_and_entry_integrity: Annotations describe selected environment facts but do not enumerate every checkpoint entry or dependency.
components.outgoing_and_incoming_roles: No accountable outgoing or incoming custodian is identified.
components.destination_boundary: Compatibility checks constrain restore but do not prove a clean destination.
components.authority_and_credentials: Runtime checks do not inventory registry, host, service, or application credentials.
components.dependencies_and_access: Rootfs image identity, runtime, kernel, CRIU features, TCP state, file locks, mounts, and networking remain external compatibility obligations.
components.open_decisions_and_deadlines: No complete operational decision or deadline ledger is carried.
components.rollback_safe_decline_and_failure_contai: Runtime mismatch refusal is a bounded fail-closed behavior, not complete rollback or recipient safe decline.
components.recipient_or_successor_acknowledgment: Inspecting annotations or satisfying runtime checks is not recipient acknowledgment of the full inventory.
components.successor_operation_from_package: This control defines metadata and refusal boundaries; it does not independently observe application continuation.
components.independent_verification: No external independent reviewer validates the entire dependency and restore chain.

positive_findings: Checkpoint images expose selected source-container and host-environment metadata.
Rootfs image identity is recorded for dependency reconstruction.
Restore requires compatibility-sensitive options for TCP state and file locks.
A runtime mismatch aborts rather than silently proceeding.
The destination's need for the original base image is explicit.
known_limits: Selected annotations are not a complete dependency and access inventory.
Runtime mismatch refusal does not prove all required compatibility checks.
The original base image remains external to the checkpoint state package.
No authority or credential ledger is carried.
No package inventory is acknowledged by a recipient.
No clean-destination receipt exists.
No public fixed checkpoint digest receipt exists.
No application continuation is independently observed in this control.
No rollback or safe-decline protocol is complete.
No external independent reproduction exists.

next_action: Seek one fixed-digest checkpoint image that is actually pushed and acquired by a demonstrably clean destination, restores application-specific state from that exact digest, carries an integrity-bound inventory of internal entries and external dependencies, receives explicit recipient acknowledgment, supports rollback or safe decline, and is reproduced by an external independent party. Do not borrow the Podman archive output receipt into the registry-image route.
